MigrationNoticeShared: This plugin extends the original Logbook and shares the same data folder, so all of your existing records will show up here once the original plugin is removed.
MigrationNoticeConflict: Running both plugins at once would log every record twice, so the logbook stays hidden until the original plugin is uninstalled:
MigrationNoticeStep1: Open poi settings and go to the plugin list.
MigrationNoticeAuto: The logbook appears here as soon as the original plugin is removed or disabled - no restart needed.
RawRecordingHelp: Appends each quest completion payload to raw/quest.jsonl under the data folder. For debugging reward handling; leave off for normal play.
